title: Walrus artwork on Epstein's wall
summary: Jay Anderson tells of Walrus artwork on Epstein's wall, about 2002 at Epstein property, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote:
And on the wall there was a big artwork
of a a woman being raped by a walrus.

plain: Jay Anderson is a guest on Jesse Michels' podcast in an episode about the financier Jeffrey Epstein and claims of a secret elite group. He relayed what a woman named Juliet Byron, who says she was there, told him about a visit to an Epstein property around 2002. According to her, a large artwork on the wall showed a woman being raped by a walrus, which Anderson brings up as a sign of something dark in that circle.
